observations: PlayStation 5 console with a custom Assassin's Creed Valhalla skin on the faceplates.
One white DualSense wireless controller is present.
The console has the original 'fat' chassis design.
Rear view shows two USB-A ports, LAN port, HDMI port, and a figure-8 power socket.
The console appears to be the Digital Edition as no disc drive bulge is visible in the profile or rear shots.
Watermark 'JAYCYPHER GAMES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are visible on all images.

photos show the exterior only; internal functionality and software status are not shown
